## Body

The migration plan keeps every step reversible and records the owner of each decision in the shared log. Each batch is validated against the previous snapshot before the next batch starts, and any mismatch stops the run. Reports are written after every batch so that a reviewer can follow the progress without reading the raw output. The team agreed that the cut-over happens only after two clean runs in a row on the full data set. Capacity is measured at the peak hour, and the limits are reviewed again whenever a new customer joins the service.
